pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-sided polygonal regions with sharply defined, jagged edge gradients. Spatial area is larger and more elongated at the base of the neck, transitioning to smaller, more compact and densely clustered geometries on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous lattice of light-colored negative space characterized by frequent tri-radial and tetra-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness of the pathways remains relatively uniform across the observed flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible as a short, upright fringe along the neck and shoulder ridge with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dark-colored avian organism (oxpecker) perched on the upper posterior flank, causing localized occlusion of the pelage pattern.
